newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 19.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 19.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Government officials said a border blockade planned by farmers' union METESZ would be illegal.
- The Parliament would probably pass the income and social security tax amendments for individual farmers within 10 days.
- Talks are underway for the creation of a fund to compensate the needy for the energy price increases.
- Natural gas users will not be compensated for the price increase.
- Health workers will reeive a 17 percent pay rise this year.
- Today's snowfalls have caused an unusual number of accidents.
